---
name: Skill terminology or grouping correction
about: Propose an exact alias, a clearer skill definition or a topic assignment
---

## Skill and proposed change

Name the existing canonical skill, its type, and the proposed alias or topic.

## Why the meanings match

Explain the equivalence using an owned example or a public primary definition.
Call out ambiguous contexts where the phrase should remain unresolved. Do not
propose merging different skill types or merely related technologies.

## Validation

Describe a positive match, a phrase that must not match, and how duplicate
mentions in one opening should be counted.

Do not include private source descriptions, report files or candidate data.
